assistance: AI-assisted (Claude): the TypeScript generator generators/statue-of-liberty.ts was written from the open evidence in the modelling notes (OSM, public lidar and aerials, licensed photographs, published dimensions), reviewed by a human against reference photos, and exported deterministically. modelingNotes: Lady Liberty, authored in metres: east +x, north +y, up +z.

The pedestal base is 40 m square, the heel is at 36.9 m and the flame tip at 83 m. The catalog raises the pedestal onto Fort Wood; the fort remains map geometry, not part of this asset. She faces south (−y), with her right (west, −x) arm holding the torch. Styled after Apple Maps' landmarks (STYLE.md): bevelled granite blocks, the loggia as recessed bands, and a smooth verdigris figure whose head, crown and arm read at 200 px. All geometry is procedural and CC0-1.0; no source mesh or textures.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "statue-of-liberty", model "statue-of-liberty"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/statue-of-liberty.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
